hints.title: Dynamic Stack Pool with Gaps
hints.text: Removing items from interior indices leaves empty slots that must be preferentially refilled by subsequent insertion calls.

hints.title: Priority Queue for Leftmost Available Stack
hints.text: Maintain a min-heap of stack indices that currently have available capacity, and prune empty trailing stacks on pop.

hints.title: Dinner Plates Blueprint
hints.text: Push pops index from heap. If index exceeds current stacks, append new stack. Pop removes from rightmost non-empty stack.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.time: O(log S) push, O(log S) popAtStack, amortized O(1) pop
complexity.notes: Min-heap maintains the lowest available stack index in logarithmic time.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Linear scanning to find the leftmost non-full stack degrades push performance to O(S).
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Heap retains indices of partially filled stacks for instant O(1) peek and O(log S) update.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Use of min-heap for available stack indices and lazy cleanup of empty trailing stacks.
